note: Per-sample budget manifest for the Viu WASM size and startup gates ([V01.01.12.06], #95;
compressedPublishSizeBytes: the brotli-compressed sum of the published wwwroot payload (post-trim,
Release), as measured by scripts/Measure-PublishBudget.ps1. Pre-compressed *.br/*.gz duplicates and
*.map files are excluded so nothing is double counted; every other published byte (the _framework
runtime + trimmed assemblies, ICU data, index.html, JS glue, and _content assets) is included.
baselineCompressedPublishSizeBytes is the reviewed measured actual behind that budget; pull-request
CI reports the head measurement's delta against the base revision's reviewed baseline.
startupBudgetMilliseconds: the boot-to-interactive ceiling for the real-browser startup lane,
enforced by scripts/Test-StartupBudget.ps1 against the JSON that scripts/Test-EndToEnd.ps1
-MeasureStartup writes (headless Chromium, >=1 warm-up + >=10 measured runs, median).
startupToleranceMilliseconds is the explicit noise allowance added to the budget;
startupBaselineMilliseconds is the reviewed measured median behind the budget.
No silent ratcheting: CI never rewrites this file. A budget change is an explicit, reviewed edit in
the pull request, so payload growth is always a deliberate decision. Budgets are seeded from the
measured actual plus ~10% headroom; when a sample legitimately grows, raise its budget here.
The measurement subject is the tracked packaged-consumer fixture scripts/fixtures/EndToEndBrowserApp,
which restores Assimalign.Viu packages exclusively from freshly packed viu/_out/packages through the
isolation that scripts/Test-EndToEnd.ps1 owns (its own global.json, NuGet configuration, and cache).
Size provenance: EndToEndBrowserApp measured 2,452,348 bytes brotli (8,376,208 raw, 32 files) on
2026-08-09 at revision 1aea7fa0fa9f82945348a18d71d0accf54e81436 with .NET SDK 10.0.302 on a local
Windows 11 arm64 runner (Snapdragon X X1E80100), via `scripts/Test-EndToEnd.ps1 -PublishOnly
-PublishDirectory _out/e2e-publish` then `scripts/Measure-PublishBudget.ps1 -PublishDirectory
_out/e2e-publish -SampleName EndToEndBrowserApp`. The 2,700,000-byte budget provides ~10.1%
headroom.
Startup provenance: boot-to-interactive median 1,107.8 ms (10 measured runs, 1,079.1-1,194.9 ms,
1 warm-up) on 2026-08-09 at the same revision/SDK/runner, via `scripts/Test-EndToEnd.ps1
-MeasureStartup -StartupWarmupRuns 1 -StartupMeasuredRuns 10`. The 1,800 ms budget plus 200 ms
tolerance leaves room for slower CI hardware while still catching structural regressions.
CI (ubuntu x64 GitHub-hosted runners) is authoritative once the scheduled lanes run there; if its
measurements differ materially from these local seeds, recalibrate through an explicit reviewed
edit citing the CI run.
